unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

signIn.rateLimited_one: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
signIn.rateLimited_other: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle_one: Staff access for {{domain}} and {{count}} other brand.
signIn.subtitle_other: Staff access for {{domain}} and {{count}} other brands.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
signIn.twoFactorRequired: Two-factor is required on this install.
signIn.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.

magicLink.title: Check your email
magicLink.subtitle: If {{email}} belongs to a staff account, a sign-in link is on its way.
magicLink.resent: Another link is on its way.

magicLinkConfirm.title: Finish signing in
magicLinkConfirm.subtitle: You opened a sign-in link. Nothing happens until you continue, so a mail scanner that opens the link cannot use it.
magicLinkConfirm.note_one: The link works once and expires {{count}} minute after it was sent. Two-factor follows if your account uses it.
magicLinkConfirm.note_other: The link works once and expires {{count}} minutes after it was sent. Two-factor follows if your account uses it.
magicLinkConfirm.notYou: Not you? Back to sign in
magicLinkConfirm.invalid: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

totp.title: Enter your code
totp.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{email}}.
totp.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor.
totp.recoveryMismatch: That recovery code is not valid, or it has already been used.
totp.mismatch_one: That code didn't match. {{count}} attempt left before a 15-minute lock.
totp.mismatch_other: That code didn't match. {{count}} attempts left before a 15-minute lock.
totp.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
totp.expired: That sign-in attempt expired. Start again.

errors.oauth-link-required: This account is not connected here yet. Sign in another way once, then connect it from your security page.
errors.oauth-identity-conflict: That account is connected to someone else here, or yours already has one from this provider. Ask an administrator for help.

oauth-link-required.title: Connect your {{provider}} account first
oauth-link-required.body: This {{provider}} account isn't connected to a Helpdock account yet. Sign in another way once, then connect {{provider}} from your security page. After that, the button signs you in.

steps.signIn: Sign in with your password or a sign-in link.
steps.open: Open Your account › Security › Sign-in methods.

oauth-domain-not-allowed.title: This {{provider}} account can't sign in here
oauth-domain-not-allowed.body: This install accepts {{provider}} accounts from its own organisation only. Use your work account, or sign in another way.

noAccount: That account cannot sign in here. Ask an administrator to invite you.

completing.title: Signing you in
completing.body: One moment while this sign-in link is checked.
completing.failed: That sign-in link has expired or has already been used.

passwordReset.sentSubtitle: If {{email}} belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way.
passwordReset.resent: Another link is on its way.
passwordReset.title: Choose a new password
passwordReset.subtitle: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
passwordReset.invalid: That reset link has expired or has already been used.
passwordReset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with it.

enrolment.title: Turn on two-factor
enrolment.subtitle: This install requires an authenticator app for every staff account.

step1.title: Scan this code
step1.body: Open your authenticator app, scan the code, then type the six digits it shows.
step1.qrAlt: QR code for setting up an authenticator app
step1.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

step2.title: Save your recovery codes
step2.body: Each code works once, and this is the only time they are shown. Keep them where you keep your other secrets.
step2.confirm: I have saved these codes somewhere safe

enrolment.expired: That sign-in attempt expired. Start again.

invite.title: You're invited to Helpdock
invite.caption_one: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} as {{role}} in {{departments}}. The link works for {{count}} more day.
invite.caption_other: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} as {{role}} in {{departments}}. The link works for {{count}} more days.
invite.next2fa: Next you'll set up two-factor authentication, which this install requires.
invite.next: You can turn on two-factor authentication from your security page.
invite.expiredTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invite.expiredBody: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask {{inviter}} to send a new one.
invite.expiredBodyUnknown: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask an administrator to send a new one.

providers.label: Accept with an account you already use
providers.mismatch: That {{provider}} account is {{account}}, but the invitation is for {{email}}. Use the {{provider}} account for that address, or choose a password instead.
providers.mismatchUnnamed: That {{provider}} account is not for {{email}}. Use the {{provider}} account for that address, or choose a password instead.
providers.mismatchLost: That {{provider}} account is not the invited address. Open the invitation link again and use the account for that address, or choose a password.
providers.expired: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask an administrator to send a new one.

passwordField.breached: This password appears in lists of leaked passwords, so attackers try it first. Choose another one.
passwordField.breachedNote: Checked on this server against a bundled list. The password is never sent anywhere else.

sso.redirectHint: You will be sent to your company's sign-in page.
sso.required: Single sign-on is required on this install.
sso.noConnection: No enabled sign-in connection matches this email domain. Ask an administrator for access.

errors.sso-email-unverified: The identity provider did not verify an allowed email address.
errors.sso-no-access: You do not have access yet. Ask an administrator to check your group mappings.
errors.sso-connection-disabled: This sign-in connection is disabled. Ask an administrator for help.
errors.sso-invalid-response: The identity provider response could not be verified. Start again.
errors.sso-identity-conflict: This account is already linked to a different single sign-on identity. Ask an administrator for help.
